text:
anya: spotted an interesting pattern during the ws keepalive rollout: region-us had a big flurry of reconnects exactly when ttl=30s was enabled for idle sockets. console graphs show socket_count down and reconnects up, but the quota/billing panels didn't show increased token usage.

liam: odd. reconnects should increment billing at resume not when socket closes. are we sure clients actually re-auth and request tokens?

sofia: i pulled a sample trace: 

``` 
-> client opens ws
-> server sends keepalive every 10s
09:20:02 idle_detected ttl=30
09:20:03 close_sent (no FIN from client)
09:20:03 reconnect_attempt auth=none
09:20:04 auth_retry token_req skipped due to cache_miss=false
```

sofia: looks like some clients don't refresh tokens on fast reconnects; proxy short-circuits token fetch if cache_miss=false which means no billing event emitted.

monitor-bot: anomaly detected: ws_reconnect_rate[region=us]=480/min (baseline 30/min) at 09:20:00 - 09:25:00

anya: so console undercounts billable reconnects because of token-cache short-circuit + sampling. also our telemetry sampling for high-frequency streams is 1/100 by default. combined, we see a big user-visible impact but low metric counts.

liam: two risks: (A) customers think they're not billed (console mismatch), (B) we're blind during rollouts because sampled telemetry is zero.

sofia: proposed mitigations: 
  1) Emit a low-cardinality "ws.reconnect_probe=1" at reconnect path before cache short-circuit. mark `telemetry_only=true` or `billing=false` to avoid billing.
  2) For rollout windows flagged by `x-rollout-id`, bump sampling to 100% for ws.* metrics for 15m.
  3) Change token cache behavior: still return cached token but emit a `billing.intent=rebill` tag so console can surface a warning if reconnects keep happening.

console-team: for (2) we prefer sampling bump only for connections with header `x-rollout-candidate: true` to avoid increasing global metrics. also add a small dashboard card that flags sample_fraction < 0.01 so on-call notices sampling effects.

liam: note on (3) we must be careful with PII/cardinality. `billing.intent` should be boolean and not include tenant ids. dashboards can join on tenant at a higher aggregated level.

anya: agree. i sketched a minimal proxy patch: 

```
# on ws reconnect
if req.headers['x-rollout-candidate'] == 'true':
  metrics.sampling.override = 1.0
  metrics.emit('ws.reconnect_probe', {telemetry_only: true})
elif reconnect and cache_hit:
  metrics.emit('ws.reconnect_probe', {telemetry_only: true, billing_intent: true})
```

sofia: small caveat: the reconnect_probe tag must be excluded from quota billing math (we already have a quota_layer flag `telemetry_only`). make sure it doesn't increment any per-tenant token counters.

monitor-bot: ticket created: TKT-9812 "ws keepalive ttl rollout: reconcile reconnect telemetry vs billing" assigned to @sofia

anya: UX change: console banner during rollouts that says "Streaming telemetry may be sampled; use rollout filter to see full events" and a link to runbook  — reduces page escalation.

console-team: we'll add a toggle in the console to "Show rollout-only metrics" and a warning pill if sample fraction < 1/10. also add a graph of `sum(ws.reconnect_probe)` with a secondary axis for `socket_count`.

liam: for short-term rollback conditions: if reconnect_rate > 200/min and probe_count < 50 in 5m, auto-rollback the TTL change. Otherwise keep and monitor for 30m.

sofia: i'm going to open PRs: proxy: sampling override + probe emit; auth: tag billing_intent without extra fetch; console: banner + probe panel. will link.

anya: thread action items: 1) apply sampling override for rollout headers now (so we can see current spike) 2) emit probes (telemetry_only) 3) update console panels and banner 4) add rollback rule to rollout controller.

sofia: quick note: ensure the rollout controller's decision uses unsampled signals (probe) not just sampled metrics to avoid blind rollbacks.

liam: good catch. also add a /runbook quick-check command for on-call to run which verifies probe density vs reconnects.

monitor-bot: update: sampling override applied to proxy-canary-us at 09:30:12 UTC; next update +10m

anya: thanks all. will post PR links and the runbook snippet here once ready. leaving thread for async updates.

liam: thanks, ghi. :rocket:
